result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make misunderstanding less permanent.

Not by forcing agreement, but by giving people the ability to hear another person’s fear, pride, and point of view without turning it into contempt. So conflict could exist without turning into hatred. And people could say, “Maybe you saw it differently than I did,” and actually mean it.
